title: NumPy: The Actual Foundation
description: Not 'a library'. Every tensor operation you will ever write is a NumPy idea wearing a different name — so learn the memory model, not just the API.
learningOutcomes: Explain an ndarray as a flat buffer interpreted through shape, strides, and dtype
Predict broadcasting and reduction shapes without running the code
Rewrite loop-based numerical code as vectorised array operations and prove the speedup

lessons.title: The ndarray Memory Model
lessons.description: Strides, contiguity, and the views-vs-copies distinction that silently corrupts data.
learningObjectives: Explain an ndarray as a buffer plus shape, strides, and dtype
Predict whether an operation returns a view or a copy
Diagnose an aliasing bug caused by an unintended view

lessons.title: dtypes and Precision
lessons.description: float32 vs float64 vs bfloat16, and why precision is a training decision.
learningObjectives: Choose a dtype from range and precision requirements
Explain mantissa/exponent tradeoffs in bfloat16 vs float16
Spot silent integer overflow and unsafe casts

lessons.title: Axis Semantics and Reductions
lessons.description: The number one source of silent bugs in array code, plus keepdims.
learningObjectives: State exactly what axis= collapses
Use keepdims to preserve broadcastability
Debug a reduction over the wrong axis

lessons.title: Broadcasting, Derived
lessons.description: Derive the alignment rules instead of memorising them.
learningObjectives: Derive the broadcasting rules from shape alignment
Predict the output shape of any broadcast
Recognise an accidental outer product

lessons.title: Fancy Indexing, Masking, and np.where
lessons.description: Selecting and rewriting data without a single loop.
learningObjectives: Distinguish basic from advanced indexing
Filter with boolean masks
Use np.where for vectorised conditionals

lessons.title: einsum
lessons.description: One notation for every contraction — and why it makes papers readable.
learningObjectives: Read Einstein summation notation
Express matmul, trace, and batch operations in einsum
Translate a paper's equation into code

lessons.title: Linear Algebra and Reproducible Randomness
lessons.description: matmul, solve, inv, svd, eig — and Generator-based seeding.
learningObjectives: Choose solve over inv and justify it
Use svd and eig appropriately
Seed reproducibly with np.random.default_rng

lessons.title: Vectorisation in Practice
lessons.description: Rewriting loops as array ops, and measuring the speedup honestly.
learningObjectives: Rewrite a loop as array operations
Benchmark correctly with repeated timing
Recognise when vectorising costs more memory than it saves

assignment.title: A Pure-NumPy Statistics Library
assignment.description: Build the Phase 1 Proof Gate: mean, std, cov, corr, PCA, k-means, and linear regression, from scratch.
learningObjectives: Implement descriptive statistics and PCA from scratch in NumPy
Benchmark against scikit-learn and explain numerical differences
Ship it typed, tested, and packaged with uv
